summary: Composites multiple TOP layers with fixed output reference, optional base/blank layers, per-layer transforms, opacity, luma, and blend operations.

key_params.name: fixedlayer
key_params.note: Output reference: basetop, blanklayer, or firstinput

key_params.name: blanklayer
key_params.note: Use blank layer reference when selected

common_gotchas: Per-layer toggles gate whether matching per-layer controls have any effect.
The official parameter is base; basetop is a fixedlayer menu value.
Operand blend modes are order-sensitive and can change alpha behavior.
Resolution and aspect choices matter when mixing differently sized sources.
key_concepts: Layer TOP performs multi-layer TOP compositing.
Fixed Layer can use a base TOP, a blank layer, or the first input as output reference.
Base and blank-layer controls establish output size and initial color/alpha.
Global controls can be overridden by per-layer fit, extend, transform, opacity, and luma settings.
Per-layer enable toggles decide whether crop, rotation, translation, scale, pivot, opacity, or luma controls matter.
Operand selects from a large composite-operation menu.
